title: mgxrl: Trust-weighted resilient consensus control for microgrids (code, trained policies and results)
description: Code, trained policies and result tables for the manuscript 'Trust-Weighted Resilient Consensus Control for Microgrids: A Physics-Structured Reinforcement Learning Framework with Verified Explanation Interfaces'. Contents: the reduced-order ten-DG islanded microgrid plant and six consensus-signal attack injectors; the Gymnasium environment with per-source trust-weight actions, safety projection and scale-normalised reward; PPO training and paired-seed evaluation; the three pre-training admissibility tests; integrated-gradients attribution, faithfulness battery and the template-versus-LLM explanation ablation; two-tier fidelity validation (stiff-solver reference, and differential comparison against the IEEE DataPort release); the mechanism sweeps behind the consensus-bias scaling law; forensic scripts for the public release; the final policies and VecNormalize statistics of every reported run; and scripts that regenerate every figure. The script reproduce_all.ps1 runs the full chain in dependency order. The IEEE DataPort release is not redistributed; the synthetic detector corpus is archived separately (doi:10.5281/zenodo.24082859). Code under Apache-2.0; result tables and figures under CC BY 4.0.
